messages.subject: morphol.disparity error
parts:
Hi-

I’m getting an error that I can’t figure out while trying to use the morphol.disparity() function. I’d appreciate any solutions or suggestions. I’m a newcomer to geomorph and geomorphometric analysis, though experienced with R and other statistical methods.

I’m pasting below some code and console output to show the error. Not fully reproducible without the data set, but I can provide more details (or the data) if needed.

Thanks much!

Chris


> #Structure of landmarks data

> str(landmarks)

num [1:19, 1:2, 1:417] 16.2 35.4 29.4 70.4 138.3 ...

- attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 3

..$ : chr [1:19] "1" "2" "3" "4" ...

..$ : NULL

..$ : chr [1:417] "BA AN 001 07-13.jpg" "BA AN 002 07-13.jpg" "BA AN 003 07-13.jpg" "BA AN 004 07-13.jpg" ...

>

> #Perform Procrustes, convert to gdf

> gpa <- gpagen(landmarks, ProcD = TRUE, Proj = TRUE)

|==================================================================================================================| 100%

> gdf <- geomorph.data.frame(shape=gpa$coords, Lake=identifiers$lakeID, DOC=identifiers$lakeDOC, captureMethod=identifiers$captureMethod, cSize=gpa$Csize, basin=as.factor(identifiers$Basin))

>

> #Look at morphological variation

> morphol.disparity(shape ~ cSize + Lake, groups=Lake, data=gdf, iter=1000)

Preliminary Model Fit... 

Coefficients estimation: 3 permutations.

|==================================================================================================================| 100%
